cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(DeluxeReverbAB763 VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ─── JUCE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if(NOT DEFINED JUCE_DIR)
    set(JUCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../JUCE")
endif()
if(EXISTS "${JUCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory("${JUCE_DIR}" JUCE_build)
else()
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(JUCE
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git
        GIT_TAG        8.0.3
        GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
        GIT_PROGRESS   TRUE)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)
endif()

# ─── Plugin target ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
juce_add_plugin(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin
    VERSION                  1.0.0
    COMPANY_NAME             "AmpSim"
    PRODUCT_NAME             "Deluxe Reverb AB763"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE "GCAS"
    PLUGIN_CODE              "DR63"
    FORMATS                  VST3 Standalone
    IS_SYNTH                 FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT         FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT        FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT           FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD  FALSE
)

juce_generate_juce_header(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin)

set(DSP_SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src")
set(DSP_INC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include")

target_sources(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin PRIVATE
    # DSP components
    "${DSP_SRC}/TriodeComponent.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/ToneStackComponent.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_SpringReverb.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_Tremolo.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_PhaseInverter.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_PowerTube6V6.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_PowerAmpSection.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_OutputTransformer.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DR_SpeakerCabinet.cpp"
    "${DSP_SRC}/DeluxeReverbAmpAB763.cpp"
    # Plugin layer
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/DR_PluginProcessor.cpp"
)

target_include_directories(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    "${DSP_INC}"
)

target_compile_definitions(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin PUBLIC
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
    JUCE_REPORT_APP_USAGE=0
    # Disable oversampling on Pi Zero / Pi 1 by adding -DDR_ENABLE_OVERSAMPLING=0
    # to the cmake command.  Default is 2× (suitable for Pi 3/4).
)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin PRIVATE /W3 /O2)
else()
    # ARM-specific flags for Pi optimisation.
    target_compile_options(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin PRIVATE
        -Wall -Wextra -O3 -ffast-math
        # Uncomment for Pi 4 / CM4 (ARMv8-A with NEON):
        # -march=armv8-a+simd -mtune=cortex-a72
        # Uncomment for Pi 3 (ARMv8 32-bit / ARMv7 NEON):
        # -march=armv7-a -mfpu=neon-vfpv4 -mfloat-abi=hard
    )
endif()

target_link_libraries(DeluxeReverbAB763Plugin PRIVATE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_audio_processors
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
)
